map.常见原因：图片分辨率太低或模块模糊（二维码靠模块边界识别）、码区被裁掉导致缺少定: Common causes: low image resolution or blurry modules (QR relies on module boundaries), cropped code area missing finder graphics, uneven lighting causing glare, and over-beautified codes (low contrast, oversized logo). Zoom in or retake, keep all corner finder squares intact, and avoid excessive tilt.

map.百分号编码非法，已按原文显示: Invalid percent-encoding; showing the raw text
map.按前缀判定载荷类型：WIFI: 用 ([TSPH]):([^;]*) 逐段提取加: Classify the payload by prefix: WIFI: extracts encryption/SSID/password/hidden with ([TSPH]):([^;]*) and unescapes SSID/password; mailto: and sms: parse pathname plus subject and body via URL; tel: strips the prefix for the number; geo: splits on ?, the first part is latitude/longitude by comma, and the q= parameter is decoded with decodeURIComponent; http(s):// is a URL; BEGIN:VCARD and BEGIN:VEVENT split each line at the first colon into key/value; anything else is plain text.
map.按前缀判定载荷类型：WIFI: 以字符状态机解析（支持 \\; \\, \\:: Decide the payload type by prefix: WIFI: parse with a character state machine (supporting \; \, \: \\ backslash escapes) to extract security type / SSID / password / hidden, then percent-decode SSID and password; mailto: and sms: use URL parsing to take the pathname and the subject, body parameters; tel: drops the prefix to get the number; geo: drops the prefix, splits on ?, takes latitude/longitude from the first half by comma, and safely decodes q= in the second half (invalid percent-encoding is shown as-is with a warning); http(s):// is treated as a URL; BEGIN:VCARD and BEGIN:VEVENT split each line into key/value at the first colon; anything else is output as plain text
map.解析二维码承载的文本载荷；本页不做图像识别、纠错或掩码还原。: Parses the text payload carried by a QR code; this page does not do image recognition, error correction, or mask recovery.
map.：Wi-Fi 按分号与反斜杠转义拆分 SSID/密码；URL 类取查询参数；vC: : Wi-Fi splits SSID/password with semicolon and backslash escaping; URL types take query parameters; vCard/calendar split key-value at the first colon.
map.：百分号编码非法时按原文显示并提示，不执行任何脚本。: : invalid percent-encoding is shown as-is with a warning; no scripts are executed.
map.：只处理已拿到的文本，不读取图片、不调用摄像头，也不做 Reed-Solomon: : handles only text you already have; it does not read images, access the camera, or perform Reed-Solomon correction.
map.按前缀判定载荷类型：WIFI: 以字符状态机解析（支持 \\; \\, \\:: Classify the payload by prefix: WIFI: parse with a character state machine (supporting \; \, \: \\ backslash escapes) to extract security type / SSID / password / hidden; SSID and password get only the protocol backslash escapes, and percent signs are kept literally (no URL decoding); mailto: and sms: use URL parsing for pathname plus subject and body; tel: drops the prefix for the number; geo: drops the prefix and splits on ?, latitude/longitude from the first half by comma, q= in the second half safely decoded (invalid percent-encoding shown as-is with a warning); http(s):// is a URL; BEGIN:VCARD and BEGIN:VEVENT split each line at the first colon into key/value; anything else is plain text.
